title: Create a complete service order for an existing client
description: Verifies that a user can create and save a new work order with client selection, motor details, parts, service items, and payment details, and that the new order is available afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the new service order flow
Select an existing client from the suggestions
Select a motor model and enter a valid displacement
Choose received parts and additional parts needed
Add service items and assign values
Record an initial payment and discount
Save the service order
Verify the service order is created
Verify the new order can be reopened

title: View and conclude an order from the modal
description: This verifies that a user can open an existing order, review its details, and conclude it successfully from the modal view.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open an order from the dashboard or history list
Review the order details in the modal
Conclude the order
Verify the order is marked as concluded
Verify the modal no longer shows the order as open

title: Open an order, review details, edit it, and conclude it
description: Verifies that a user can open an existing service order, inspect its details, update fields, save changes, and conclude the order from the modal.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open an existing service order from the dashboard or history
Verify the order details modal is displayed
Verify the financial breakdown and line items are visible
Edit one or more order fields
Save the order changes
Conclude the order
Verify the order is concluded

title: Edit and save order changes from the modal
description: This verifies that a user can open an existing order, update its data, and save the changes from the modal.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open an order from the dashboard or history list
Start editing the order
Update the order data
Save the changes
Verify the updated order details are displayed
Verify the order remains accessible from the modal

title: Register a new client with complete details
description: Verifies that a user can create a client record with identity, contact, city, and type information and save it successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the clients section
Start adding a new client
Fill in the name field with a new client name
Fill in the document field with a valid document number
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the WhatsApp field with a valid WhatsApp number
Fill in the city field with a city name
Select the client type
Save the client record
Verify the client is created
Verify the client appears in the client list

title: Validate required fields when creating a service order
description: Verifies that trying to save a new work order with missing required information shows validation feedback and allows the user to complete and save it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the new service order flow
Attempt to save the order without completing the required fields
Verify validation feedback is visible
Complete the missing required order information
Save the service order
Verify the service order is created

title: Search and open a client record from the clients list
description: Verifies that a user can search for a client, see filtered results, and open the client overview and history.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the clients section
Enter a client search term
Verify the filtered client results are shown
Open a client from the filtered results
Verify the client overview is displayed
Verify the client history is displayed

title: Open a client history and jump to a related service order
description: Verifies that a user can move from a client record to its history and then open a related order for review.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the clients section
Search for a client with existing history
Open the client record
Open a related service order from the client history
Verify the service order details modal is displayed
Verify the order line items are visible

title: Show validation for an incomplete client registration
description: Verifies that required client fields must be completed and that validation feedback appears before the client can be saved.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the clients section
Start adding a new client
Attempt to save the client with required information missing
Verify validation feedback is visible
Complete the missing client information
Save the client record
Verify the client is created

title: Print an order report from the modal
description: This verifies that a user can open an existing order and access the printable report flow from the modal.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open an order from the dashboard or history list
Open the print report flow
Verify a printable report view is displayed
Verify the order report content is visible

title: Prevent concluding an invalid order
description: This verifies that a user attempting to conclude an order with missing required information sees validation feedback and can complete the action after correcting the data.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open an order from the dashboard or history list
Attempt to conclude the order with incomplete information
Verify a validation error is visible
Correct the missing information
Conclude the order
Verify the order is marked as concluded

title: Handle an empty client search result
description: Verifies that searching for unmatched client terms shows an empty state instead of results.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the clients section
Enter a search term that matches no clients
Verify an empty state message is visible
Verify no client results are shown
